title: Create lexical aliases and elevation presets for compact components
creator: Priya Desai
description: Problem: As Redwood introduces higher-density UI (compact tables, condensed cards, and cramped action bars), existing token names and elevation presets are misaligned with developer usage. Engineers are creating ad-hoc overrides (box-shadow tweaks, manual radii) which fractures visual consistency and complicates runtime theming. Goal: Define a lexical alias layer and a small set of elevation/shadow presets targeted at compact components, plus compact typography/spacing steps. Deliverables: 1) Token lexicon (alias layer) that maps semantic names (surface-1, surface-2, interactive-hover, separator-weak) to canonical colors and alpha ramps for light/dark; 2) Compact scale variants for typography (compact-step-0..3) and spacing (gap-compact-1..4); 3) Elevation presets tuned for dense UIs: micro, micro-hover, micro-active and micro-divider; 4) Migration guidance and codemod snippets for engineers; 5) Figma components updated and a short rollout plan that preserves a11y contrast targets. Constraints and tradeoffs: we must not change legacy tokens for large-surface apps in this ticket — this is an additive aliasing layer. Micro-elevations will be subtle by design to avoid introducing new contrast failures. Accessibility: acceptance requires WCAG AA for text over primary surfaces and contrast checks for separators at minimum 3:1 when used for affordances. Metrics: reduce token overrides in GH by 80% in three sprints and remove 1 manually-created shadow per feature area on average.
migration_plan: Phase 1: Publish alias tokens (non-breaking) and update Figma libraries - designers approve visual QA.
Phase 2: Add compact variants to component props (Button.size='compact', Table.density='compact') - engineering feature flags used.
Phase 3: Run codemod to replace common inline shadows and radii in top 30 repos, open PRs for review.
Phase 4: Monitor Console metrics for visual regressions and token override counts; rollback if regressions exceed threshold.
Phase 5: Remove temporary overrides and mark migration complete in docs.
acceptance_criteria: Alias token layer exists and maps to canonical colors for light/dark themes.
Figma library updated: all compact components show new radii, spacing, and micro-elevations.
Engineering PRs add compact props to Button, Table, Card components with feature flag guarded rollout.
Automated contrast checks pass for top 10 screens in design QA run (WCAG AA).
Codemod script available and used to replace manual shadow overrides in at least 5 repos for initial rollout.
